description: This is a Java unit test class for testing the ConditionValidator component in the OpenMRS project. It contains test methods to verify validation logic for the Condition class, including null checks and property validation.

classes.name: ConditionValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ConditionValidator, verifying validation logic such as handling null inputs, incorrect types, and valid condition objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating instances of ConditionValidator, Condition, and Errors before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws an IllegalArgumentException when given a null Condition object.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenInstanceOfClassOtherThanCondition
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws an IllegalArgumentException when given an object of a different class (Cohort).

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenConditionWithNullConditionProperties
methods.description: Verifies that validation errors occur when essential properties of a Condition are null.

methods.name: shouldPassIfConditionClassIsPassedWithRequiredConditionProperties
methods.description: Confirms that a properly filled Condition object passes validation without errors.
